name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 25, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Deacon Ron Arnold of St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Letters of Appreciation to Tom Dubose and Juan Paz from the Sheriff’s Department for contributions to graffiti tracking.
P2.
Proclamation to Rosemarie Reno, of the Tri-City Medical Center Board of Directors, who has been named "Trustee of the Year" and declaring June 26, 2013, Rosemarie Reno Day in the City of Vista.
P3.
Certificates of Appointment to Incoming Commission and Committee Members.
P4.
San Diego Gas & Electric Summer Outlook
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
2013 League Conference Voting Delegate and Alternate (CC)
C4.
Delegating Investment Authority to the City Treasurer for FY 2013/14 (CC)
C5.
Encina Wastewater Authority Budget for Fiscal Year 2013/14 (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- .
C6.
2013 Justice Assistance Grant (CC)
C7.
Civic Center Audio Visual Maintenance Services Second Amendment (CC)
C8.
Termination of the San Diego Housing and Financing Agency JPA (CC)
C9.
License Agreement for Remediation and Demolition Activities (SA)
C10.
Long-Range Property Management Plan (SA)
C11.
Agreement with VCMA and Management, and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan Amendments (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , Approving a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Vista and the Vista City Maintenance Association.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , Approving a Letter of Agreement between the City of Vista and the Vista City Maintenance Association.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , Amending the Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan and repealing all Resolutions in conflict herewith.
C12.
Fiscal Year 2013/14 Operating Budget (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following, approving the FY 2013/14 Operating Budget:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- ,
b.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- ,
c.
Community Development Commission Resolution
No. 2013- ; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the city-wide Classification and Compensation Index
and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
C13.
Payment to County for Distribution to Taxing Entities Resulting from Due Diligence Review (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2012/13;
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- , appropriating funds for a payment due resulting from the Other Funds Due Diligence Review; and
3.
Adopt the following, approving a Loan Agreement to Partially Fund Due Diligence Payment by the Successor Agency to the County of San Diego Auditor-Controller:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- ,
b.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- .
DISCUSSION
D1.
Expansion of Existing City Prohibitions on Smoking (CC)
1.
Introduce and adopt the sample ordinance provided by Councilman Campbell, entitled "Repealing and Replacing Chapter 8.12 of the Vista Municipal Code to Regulate Smoking and Tobacco Product Use in Enclosed and Public Unenclosed Areas"; or
2.
Introduce and adopt an ordinance, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 8.12 to the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Smoking"; or
3.
Direct staff to conduct further research and outreach, and bring back modifications to Vista Municipal Code Chapter 8.12 for City Council consideration at a future meeting.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
